audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra purification/sin offering text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for unintentional sin/misalignment, priest, congregation, leader, common person, blood/life manipulation, and forgiveness.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel, saying: When a soul/life sins/misaligns in error/unintentionally from any commands of YHWH that should not be done, and does one from them,

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

modern.text: “Tell the Israelites to do as follows with one who sins unintentionally against any of the LORD’s commandments and does what is forbidden by them:

original.text: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לֵאמֹר֒ נֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי תֶחֱטָ֤א בִשְׁגָגָה֙ מִכֹּל֙ מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ינָה וְעָשָׂ֕ה מֵאַחַ֖ת מֵהֵֽנָּה

verses.restored: if anointed priest sins/misaligns, bringing guilt upon the people, then he shall bring near for his sin/misalignment that he sinned a bull, son of herd, complete one, to YHWH for sin/misalignment offering.

familiar.text: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.

modern.text: If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the LORD a young bull without blemish as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.

original.text: אִ֣ם הַכֹּהֵ֧ן הַמָּשִׁ֛יחַ יֶחֱטָ֖א לְאַשְׁמַ֣ת הָעָ֑ם וְהִקְרִ֡יב עַ֣ל חַטָּאתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטָ֜א פַּ֣ר בֶּן בָּקָ֥ר תָּמִ֛ים לַיהוָ֖ה לְחַטָּֽאת

verses.restored: He shall bring the bull to entrance of tent of meeting before YHWH, lay his hand on head of bull, and slaughter bull before YHWH.

familiar.text: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock’s head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.

modern.text: He must bring the bull to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, lay his hand on the bull’s head, and slaughter it before the LORD.

original.text: וְהֵבִ֣יא אֶת הַפָּ֗ר אֶל פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת יָדוֹ֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַפָּ֔ר וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: The anointed priest shall take from blood/life of bull and bring it into tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock’s blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

modern.text: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and bring it into the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְלָקַ֛ח הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֑ר וְהֵבִ֥יא אֹת֖וֹ אֶל אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: The priest shall dip his finger in blood/life and sprinkle from blood/life seven times before YHWH, before veil of holy place.

familiar.text: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.

modern.text: The priest is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.

original.text: וְטָבַ֧ל הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ בַּדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן הַדָּ֜ם שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶת פְּנֵ֖י פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: The priest shall put from blood/life on horns of altar of fragrant incense before YHWH in tent of meeting, and all blood/life of bull he shall pour at base of altar of burnt offering at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: The priest must then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. And he is to pour out the rest of the bull’s blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְנָתַן֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן מִן הַדָּ֜ם עַל קַ֠רְנוֹת מִזְבַּ֨ח קְטֹ֤רֶת הַסַּמִּים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת כָּל דַּ֣ם הַפָּ֗ר יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: All fat of bull of sin/misalignment offering he shall lift from it: fat covering inward parts and all fat on inward parts,

familiar.text: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

modern.text: Then he shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them,

original.text: וְאֶת כָּל חֵ֛לֶב פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת הַחֵ֨לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה עַל הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַקֶּֽרֶב

verses.restored: two kidneys and fat on them by loins, and lobe on liver; with kidneys he shall remove it,

familiar.text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,

modern.text: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he is to remove with the kidneys—

original.text: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת הַחֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל הַכְּלָי֖וֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה

verses.restored: as it is lifted from ox of sacrifice of peace/well-being; priest shall turn them into smoke on altar of burnt offering.

familiar.text: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

modern.text: just as the fat is removed from the ox of the peace offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

original.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יוּרַ֔ם מִשּׁ֖וֹר זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְהִקְטִירָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה

verses.restored: But skin of bull and all its flesh, with its head, legs, inward parts, and dung,

familiar.text: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

modern.text: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, with its head and legs and its entrails and dung—

original.text: וְאֶת ע֤וֹר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת כָּל בְּשָׂר֔וֹ עַל רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְעַל כְּרָעָ֑יו וְקִרְבּ֖וֹ וּפִרְשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: all the bull he shall bring out to outside of camp, to clean place, to ash-pour, and burn it on wood with fire; upon ash-pour it shall be burned.

familiar.text: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.

modern.text: all the rest of the bull—he must take outside the camp to a ceremonially clean place where the ashes are poured out, and there he must burn it on a wood fire on the ash heap.

original.text: וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת כָּל הַ֠פָּר אֶל מִח֨וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה אֶל מָק֤וֹם טָהוֹר֙ אֶל שֶׁ֣פֶךְ הַדֶּ֔שֶׁן וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֹת֛וֹ עַל עֵצִ֖ים בָּאֵ֑שׁ עַל שֶׁ֥פֶךְ הַדֶּ֖שֶׁן יִשָּׂרֵֽף

verses.restored: If all congregation of Israel errs, and matter is hidden from eyes of assembly, and they do one from all commands of YHWH that should not be done, and become guilty,

familiar.text: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;

modern.text: Now if the whole congregation of Israel strays unintentionally and the matter escapes the notice of the assembly so that they violate any of the LORD’s commandments and incur guilt by doing what is forbidden,

original.text: וְאִ֨ם כָּל עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְנֶעְלַ֣ם דָּבָ֔ר מֵעֵינֵ֖י הַקָּהָ֑ל וְ֠עָשׂוּ אַחַ֨ת מִכָּל מִצְוֺ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְאָשֵֽׁמוּ

verses.restored: when sin/misalignment becomes known that they sinned, assembly shall bring near bull, son of herd, for sin/misalignment offering, and bring it before tent of meeting.

familiar.text: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: when they become aware of the sin they have committed, then the assembly must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְנֽוֹדְעָה֙ הַֽחַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטְא֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וְהִקְרִ֨יבוּ הַקָּהָ֜ל פַּ֤ר בֶּן בָּקָר֙ לְחַטָּ֔את וְהֵבִ֣יאוּ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Elders of congregation shall lay their hands on head of bull before YHWH, and bull shall be slaughtered before YHWH.

familiar.text: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.

modern.text: The elders of the congregation are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the LORD, and it shall be slaughtered before the LORD.

original.text: וְ֠סָמְכוּ זִקְנֵ֨י הָעֵדָ֧ה אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֛ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Anointed priest shall bring from blood/life of bull into tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock’s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

modern.text: Then the anointed priest is to bring some of the bull’s blood into the Tent of Meeting,

original.text: וְהֵבִ֛יא הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֑ר אֶל אֹ֖הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: The priest shall dip his finger from blood/life and sprinkle seven times before YHWH, before veil.

familiar.text: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.

modern.text: and he is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the veil.

original.text: וְטָבַ֧ל הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ מִן הַדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֞ה שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֥י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת

verses.restored: He shall put from blood/life on horns of altar before YHWH, which is in tent of meeting, and all blood/life pour at base of altar of burnt offering at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: He is also to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting, and he must pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וּמִן הַדָּ֞ם יִתֵּ֣ן עַל קַרְנֹ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת כָּל הַדָּ֗ם יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: All its fat he shall lift from it and turn into smoke on altar.

familiar.text: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.

modern.text: And he is to remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar.

original.text: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל חֶלְבּ֖וֹ יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה

verses.restored: He shall do to bull as he did to bull of sin/misalignment offering; thus he shall do to it. Priest shall make atonement/covering for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

familiar.text: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

modern.text: He shall offer this bull just as he did the bull for the sin offering; in this way the priest will make atonement on their behalf, and they will be forgiven.

original.text: וְעָשָׂ֣ה לַפָּ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְפַ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֔את כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂה לּ֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֧ר עֲלֵהֶ֛ם הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנִסְלַ֥ח לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: He shall bring bull outside camp and burn it as he burned first bull; it is sin/misalignment offering for assembly.

familiar.text: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.

modern.text: Then he is to take the bull outside the camp and burn it, just as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

original.text: וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת הַפָּ֗ר אֶל מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְשָׂרַ֣ף אֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂרַ֔ף אֵ֖ת הַפָּ֣ר הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן חַטַּ֥את הַקָּהָ֖ל הֽוּא

verses.restored: When a leader sins/misaligns and does one from all commands of YHWH his Divine that should not be done, in error/unintentionally, and becomes guilty,

familiar.text: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;

modern.text: When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited by any of the commandments of the LORD his God, he incurs guilt.

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשִׂ֖יא יֶֽחֱטָ֑א וְעָשָׂ֡ה אַחַ֣ת מִכָּל מִצְוֺת֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֜יו אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂ֛ינָה בִּשְׁגָגָ֖ה וְאָשֵֽׁם

verses.restored: or his sin/misalignment that he sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a male goat, complete one.

familiar.text: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

modern.text: When he becomes aware of the sin he has committed, he must bring an unblemished male goat as his offering.

original.text: אֽוֹ הוֹדַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ חַטָּאת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א בָּ֑הּ וְהֵבִ֧יא אֶת קָרְבָּנ֛וֹ שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים זָכָ֥ר תָּמִֽים

verses.restored: He shall lay his hand on head of goat and slaughter it in place where burnt offering is slaughtered before YHWH; it is sin/misalignment offering.

familiar.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it is a sin offering.

modern.text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the goat and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the LORD. It is a sin offering.

original.text: וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔וֹ בִּמְק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת הָעֹלָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא

verses.restored: The priest shall take from blood/life of sin/misalignment offering with his finger and put on horns of altar of burnt offering, and its blood/life he shall pour at base of altar of burnt offering.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

modern.text: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

original.text: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת דָּמ֣וֹ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל יְס֖וֹד מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה

verses.restored: All its fat he shall turn into smoke on altar, like fat of sacrifice of peace/well-being. Priest shall make atonement/covering for him from his sin/misalignment, and it shall be forgiven him.

familiar.text: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

modern.text: He must burn all its fat on the altar, like the fat of the peace offerings; thus the priest will make atonement for that man’s sin, and he will be forgiven.

original.text: וְאֶת כָּל חֶלְבּוֹ֙ יַקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה כְּחֵ֖לֶב זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ

verses.restored: If one soul/life from people of land sins/misaligns in error/unintentionally by doing one from commands of YHWH that should not be done, and becomes guilty,

familiar.text: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

modern.text: And if one of the common people sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited by any of the LORD’s commandments, he incurs guilt.

original.text: וְאִם נֶ֧פֶשׁ אַחַ֛ת תֶּחֱטָ֥א בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֠עֲשֹׂתָהּ אַחַ֨ת מִמִּצְוֺ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְאָשֵֽׁם

verses.restored: or his sin/misalignment that he sinned is made known to him, he shall bring his offering, female goat, complete one, for his sin/misalignment that he sinned.

familiar.text: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

modern.text: When he becomes aware of the sin he has committed, he must bring an unblemished female goat as his offering for that sin.

original.text: א֚וֹ הוֹדַ֣ע אֵלָ֔יו חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְהֵבִ֨יא קָרְבָּנ֜וֹ שְׂעִירַ֤ת עִזִּים֙ תְּמִימָ֣ה נְקֵבָ֔ה עַל חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא

verses.restored: He shall lay his hand on head of sin/misalignment offering and slaughter sin/misalignment offering in place of burnt offering.

familiar.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

modern.text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.

original.text: וְסָמַךְ֙ אֶת יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְשָׁחַט֙ אֶת הַ֣חַטָּ֔את בִּמְק֖וֹם הָעֹלָֽה

verses.restored: The priest shall take from its blood/life with his finger and put on horns of altar of burnt offering, and all its blood/life pour at base of altar.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

modern.text: Then the priest is to take some of its blood with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

original.text: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִדָּמָהּ֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת כָּל דָּמָ֣הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: All its fat he shall remove, as fat is removed from sacrifice of peace/well-being, and priest shall turn it into smoke on altar as soothing scent to YHWH. Priest shall make atonement/covering for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

familiar.text: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

modern.text: Then he is to remove all the fat, just as it is removed from the peace offering, and the priest is to burn it on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD. In this way the priest will make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

original.text: וְאֶת כָּל חֶלְבָּ֣הּ יָסִ֗יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּסַ֣ר חֵלֶב֮ מֵעַ֣ל זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֒ וְהִקְטִ֤יר הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ

verses.restored: If he brings lamb as his offering for sin/misalignment offering, a complete female he shall bring.

familiar.text: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

modern.text: If, however, he brings a lamb as a sin offering, he must bring an unblemished female.

familiar.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

modern.text: And he is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

verses.restored: The priest shall take from blood/life of sin/misalignment offering with his finger and put on horns of altar of burnt offering, and all its blood/life pour at base of altar.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

modern.text: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

original.text: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת כָּל דָּמָ֣הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: All its fat he shall remove, as fat of lamb is removed from sacrifice of peace/well-being, and priest shall turn them into smoke on altar upon fire-offerings of YHWH. Priest shall make atonement/covering for him over his sin/misalignment that he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

familiar.text: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

modern.text: And he shall remove all the fat, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the peace offerings, and he shall burn it on the altar along with the offerings made by fire to the LORD. translation_notes: This chapter focuses on unintentional/error sin, not deliberate defiance; avoid shame-overreach.
Chatat is often 'sin offering' but also functions as purification offering; flag for lexical audit.
Different social locations are addressed: priest, whole congregation, leader, common person.
Forgiveness formula is explicit: atonement/covering is made, and it shall be forgiven.
safety_note: Do not use Leviticus 4 to create obsessive guilt. The chapter addresses hidden/unintentional misalignment that becomes known and gives a ritual path for repair and forgiveness.
